status: exploratory public executed-fist baseline; no local Unicorn transfer validation

config.filter: 4th-order Butterworth 7-35 Hz; causal sosfilt; reset per window; subtract first sample
config.features: log Welch bandpower; nperseg=500; band-major, then recorded channel order

external_import_config.source_unit: uV in EDF header; MNE returns V
external_import_config.resampling: per-history scipy.signal.resample_poly(up=25, down=16, axis=0, window=('kaiser', 5.0), padtype='constant', cval=0)
external_import_config.timing: Cue rounded to nearest 160-Hz sample; exclusive stop after 560 source samples. No source samples outside this history.

feature_config.filter: 4th-order Butterworth 7-35 Hz; causal sosfilt; reset per window; subtract first sample
feature_config.features: log Welch bandpower; nperseg=500; band-major, then recorded channel order

training_parameters.scaling: StandardScaler fitted only on training people in every fold
training_parameters.final_model: refit on all 4725 public trials after evaluation

descriptive_person_bootstrap.quantity: unweighted mean of observed held-out-person balanced accuracies
descriptive_person_bootstrap.limitation: Descriptive only: folds share training data; this is not a formal independent confidence interval for the entire learning procedure or a significance test.

real_output_checks: 4725 unique trials, each tested exactly once
105 held-out people, all three runs and 45 trials together
per-fold and pooled metrics recalculated from saved test predictions
exported model reloaded without pickle; scaler equals full-data refit statistics
exported probabilities finite, shape 4725 x 2, each row sums to one
prepared input checksums and all cached feature histories verified by training loader

limitations: Structural checks do not validate artifact-free EEG or correct cue compliance.
Only left/right executed fists; no rest, foot or imagery class.
Per-history centered FIR resampling is offline; not a validated streaming adapter.
No additional reference or artifact correction; source/device differences remain.
No split is learned here; later evaluation must hold out whole people.
Generic local EEG 1..8 names still require independently verified physical placement.
Public-data cross-person evaluation is not a local Unicorn transfer or streaming validation.
Model probabilities are uncalibrated; no event gating is defined without a rest class.
105 folds share training people; no independent final cohort or external dataset test.
Eight-channel bandpower baseline; no performance claim for alternative models.
No formal permutation significance test and no hyperparameter search performed.
